hero.title: How members save, participate, and win
hero.description: A simple step by step process where every member pay a 100 rupee membership, keeps building savings through purchase activity, and moves closer to the final draw or coupon opening.

steps.title: 1. Pay the membership fee
steps.description: Every member starts by paying a RS:100 membership fee, which gives access to the program and activates participation in the savings and prize draw system.

steps.title: 2. Purchase and save
steps.description: When a member purchases through the program, their savings begin to build automatically. Every purchase adds positive value to the member journey.

steps.title: 3. Business coupon / draw participation
steps.description: Across all programs, business and purchase based coupons are issued so that each member remains connected to the draw structure and reward cycle.

steps.title: 4. Savings keep growing
steps.description: The cumulative savings are tracked and reinforced as members continue purchasing, creating a stronger pool of value for the next stage.

steps.title: 5. Final coupon opens
steps.description: Once the collection phase is complete, the final coupon or draw is opened, giving the member a chance to win the final reward or prize result.

steps.title: 6. Reward is announced
steps.description: The final result is announced, and the winning member receives the reward, closing the cycle with a clear and rewarding conclusion.

why.paragraph: The structure is built around a straightforward idea: a small membership creates entry, purchases drive value, and the savings process keeps moving forward until the last draw or final coupon is opened.

flowList: Member purchase is made under the active program
Savings begin to accumulate for the member
Business draw / coupon system remains active across all programs
The final prize in rupees is announced when the last coupon opens

overview.title: Member Journey
overview.savingsText: Each purchase adds to the value created for the member.
overview.drawText: The last opening delivers the final opportunity for the reward.

highlights.title: Community based program
highlights.text: Members join as one connected group, creating a shared cycle of savings, rewards, and participation.

highlights.title: Transparent process
highlights.text: The flow is designed to be clear and easy to understand, from membership to accumulation and final result.

highlights.title: Rewards are meaningful
highlights.text: With each purchase and savings contribution, members move closer to the final lucky draw and benefit outcome.

highlights.title: Built for growth
highlights.text: The structure encourages repeat participation while keeping the experience simple, rewarding, and professional.

benefits.paragraph: Empowering your journey with clarity, security, and proven value every step of the way.

cta.title: Join the process and keep moving toward the final opening
cta.paragraph: The model is simple: pay membership, purchase, save, participate in the draw, and unlock the final reward moment when the last coupon opens.
